title.note: Game title, glossary keep; the Russian guide keeps game titles in English because players search for the English name.

hud.cast.note: Infinitive, the Russian button norm; everyday angling phrase "закинуть удочку". "Забросить" (9) is more standard but one over the 8 budget; noun "Заброс" (6) works if a noun is preferred.

hud.reel.note: Infinitive "pull (the line/fish) in", pairs with "Закинуть" in the same slot. Same root as the pass name "Автовытягивание".

hud.bait_left.note: Label form avoids number agreement (0, 1, 12 all read right). "Наживка" is the angling word for bait on the hook. 9/10.

hud.backpack.note: Roblox's own Russian UI word for Backpack (CoreScript: "Рюкзак", "Закрыть рюкзак").

catch.success.note: Restructured as "[Rare] catch: [Golden Carp]!": the masculine rarity label agrees with the fixed noun "улов" (catch), never with the unseen fish. "You caught" dropped to avoid a gendered past verb ("поймал/поймала"). Every rarity tier must be translated in the masculine (Редкий, Легендарный, Мифический).

catch.escaped.note: "It" made explicit as the generic "рыба"; "сорвалась" is the angling verb for a fish coming off the hook. Single ellipsis character per the guide; use it (not three periods) in every Russian string of this game.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; Russian writes a decimal comma ("12,4"). Format the number per locale in code.

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name, built like the Russian species pattern рыба-клоун / рыба-меч; the diminutive "фонарик" keeps the glowing lantern and the cozy tone. Masculine nominative. Alternative: "Фонарный угорь" (14).

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine tier label (agrees with "улов" in catch.success); reads above "Легендарный". 10/10.

shop.equip.note: "Take (in hand)", paired with the state label "В руках". "Экипировать" (11) is over budget and stiff; "Выбрать" / "Выбрана" is the plainer UI pair if the reviewer prefers it.

shop.equipped.note: "In hand": a state, not an action, and needs no gender agreement with "удочка". Alternative: "Выбрана" (7, feminine, agrees with удочка).

shop.free.note: The standard Russian price word; 9 vs the estimated 8. If the label really holds only 8, use "Даром" (5), which is shorter but more colloquial.

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux stays Latin and undeclined, as in Roblox's Russian UI.

pass.auto_reel.note: Built like the common UI word "автосохранение"; same root as hud.reel "Тянуть". 15 vs the estimated 14. Must match the pass name set in Creator Hub.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Наживка удачи удваивает шанс поймать редкую рыбу!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name from the glossary words luck (удача) and Bait (наживка), patterned on "Зелье удачи". "your" dropped, as Russian does.

sell.done.note: Label form avoids plural agreement (1 рыба / 2 рыбы / 5 рыб; 1 монета / 2 монеты / 5 монет). For the developer: format large coin values with a space as thousands separator for Russian.

sell.prompt.note: Latin E. "Нажми E, чтобы продать" is 22, one over the 21 budget; "Жми" is the common, natural game-prompt imperative. For the developer: a ProximityPrompt ActionText "Продать" would also serve phone and console players.

ascend.button.note: Term choice for Ascend: "Вознесение" is the religious Ascension and "Восхождение" reads as climbing, both excluded by the glossary; "Возвышение" (rise in rank) is neither. Noun on a button, as with "Перерождение". 10/10. "Престиж" (7) is the fallback if players should see the generic prestige word.

ascend.confirm.text: Возвыситься сейчас? Ты начнёшь заново, но будешь ловить редкую рыбу на {bonus}% чаще.
ascend.confirm.note: Verb of the same root as the button "Возвышение"; change both together if the term changes. Future tense keeps the player ungendered.

weather.storm.note: "Клюёт" is the angling verb for fish biting; word order puts "rare fish" last, where Russian puts new information.

quest.catch_n.text: Поймай рыбу в Лунной бухте: {n} шт.
quest.catch_n.note: "шт." after the number avoids plural agreement (1 рыбу / 2 рыбы / 5 рыб). Moonlit Bay = "Лунная бухта" (terms), declined here; any in-world sign should read "Лунная бухта".

friends.boost.text: Рыбалка с друзьями даёт +{percent}% к удаче
friends.boost.note: "+N% к удаче" is the standard Russian stat-bonus phrasing.

trade.sent.note: Fixed noun head "Игроку" keeps the name undeclined and the sentence ungendered. 33/33.

trade.accept.note: "принял" agrees with the fixed noun "Игрок", so it is correct for any player gender; "your trade" rendered as the trade request, matching trade.sent.

codes.redeemed.note: "Enjoy your reward" rendered as the friendly "here's your reward" ("Держи награду"); a literal "Наслаждайся наградой" reads as a calque. "активирован" is the Russian redeem verb for codes.

afk.kicked.text: Рыбалка остановлена из-за слишком долгого бездействия.
afk.kicked.note: Restructured around the cause because "Ты бездействовал(а)" would be gendered; Roblox's Russian UI also words idle kicks as "из-за неактивности". Adds no server removal.

event.ends.note: Standard Russian countdown label ("remaining"). For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; Russian expects "2 д 4 ч". Format durations per locale in code.

daily.streak.text: {day}-й день подряд! Заходи завтра за новой наградой.
daily.streak.note: "Nth day in a row" is how Russian says a login streak; the masculine ordinal suffix "-й" is right for every number. Glossary streak = "серия", which this sentence does not need. "for more" = the next daily reward.

tip.night.text: Совет: некоторые рыбы клюют только ночью.

group.join.text: Вступи в нашу группу и получи 50 наживок бесплатно!
group.join.note: "группа" is Roblox's Russian word for groups; "нашу" added because a bare "the group" is unclear in Russian. "50 наживок" counts bait as units, matching the HUD counter; "наживка x50" is the alternative if that reads odd.

leaderboard.biggest.note: The standard name of the heaviest-fish prize in Russian fishing contests; "крупная" means big by weight. 18/18.
